text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list: Good morning! Did you rest well yesterday?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—thanks to you.
Were you able to get proper rest, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... What a relief.
Your complexion looks much brighter too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "You always seem so busy, so I've been worried about you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I hope... you are doing well today too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kind-hearted Curren Bouquetd'or seemed more concerned about whether I had gotten proper rest than about herself.
